facts.statement: Isaberrysaura was a stegosaurian ornithischian dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic in the Los Molles Formation of Patagonia, Argentina.
facts.quote: Isaberrysaura is an extinct genus of stegosaurian ornithischian dinosaurs from the Middle Jurassic Los Molles Formation of Patagonia, Argentina.

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura lived approximately 168 million years ago during the Bajocian stage of the Middle Jurassic.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, en el bajociense, hace 168 millones de años

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura was estimated to be around 5 to 6 meters long, representing a dinosaur of moderate size.
facts.quote: Isaberrysaura is also estimated to have measured around 5 to 6 m long, making it of moderate size.

facts.statement: The skull is unusually shaped, estimated to be 52 cm long and 20 cm wide across the orbits, and nearly as high as it is wide.
facts.quote: El cráneo en particular es muy inusual; se estimó que mediría 52 centímetros de longitud y 20 centímetros de ancho entre las órbitas oculares, y es casi tan alto como ancho.

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura had heterodont dentition consisting of six premaxillary teeth and thirty maxillary teeth.
facts.quote: La dentadura es heterodonte, con seis dientes premaxilares y treinta dientes maxilares.

facts.statement: Fossilized seeds were found within the rib cage of the holotype, representing the first preserved meal ever uncovered in a basal ornithischian dinosaur.
facts.quote: Within the rib cage, a mass of fossilized seeds was discovered; the first preserved meal uncovered in a basal ornithischian.

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura resembled stegosaurs in general appearance but lacked their characteristic bony plates and may have had a bipedal posture.
facts.quote: La apariencia general de este animal recuerda mucho a la de los estegosaurios, excepto por la carencia de sus características placas óseas y por tener posiblemente una postura bípeda.

facts.statement: Although initially thought to be a basal neornithischian, Isaberrysaura is now allied with Stegosauria due to skull morphology resembling other members of that group.
facts.quote: Although initially classified as a basal neornithischian, subsequent analyses have allied it with the Stegosauria as the morphology of its skull resembles those of other members of the group.

facts.statement: Several subsequent phylogenetic analyses have confidently classified Isaberrysaura as a stegosaur.
facts.quote: However, several subsequent phylogenetic analyses have confidently recovered Isaberrysaura as a stegosaur.

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura was initially considered to be a basal neornithischian.
facts.quote: aunque se consideró en principio que era un neornistisquio basal.

facts.statement: While its teeth suggest an omnivorous diet, the absence of animal remains alongside seeds makes this conclusion speculative.
facts.quote: Based on its teeth, it is possible that the dinosaur had an omnivorous diet, but as no trace of animal remains have been found alongside the seeds, this remains speculative at best.

facts.statement: It is debated whether enzyme-producing bacteria were present in Isaberrysaura's gut to aid in digesting tough plant material like seeds.
facts.quote: It also remains possible that there were enzyme-producing bacteria present in the dinosaur's gut to aid in digesting tougher plant material as seeds.

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura was initially placed in the Genasauria group at the base of the ornithischian family tree.
facts.quote: fue situado en el grupo Genasauria, en la base del árbol familiar de ese grupo de ornitisquios

facts.statement: Salgado et al. noted that Isaberrysaura possessed characteristics of both neornithischians and thyreophorans but did not fit within those specific groups.
facts.quote: Tres conjuntos de datos incluidos en la descripción científica hecha por Salgado et al indicaron que aunque poseía características de los neornitisquios y los tireóforos, no encajaba dentro de esos grupos

facts.statement: A later phylogenetic analysis by Han et al. suggested that Isaberrysaura would be one of the most basal known members of the stegosaurs.
facts.quote: Posteriormente, un análisis filogenético realizado por Han et al. (en prensa) encontró que Isaberrysaura sería uno de los miembros más basales conocidos de los estegosaurios

facts.statement: The parent group of Isaberrysaura is Huayangosauridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Huayangosauridae

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura belongs to the family Huayangosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Huayangosauridae

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura is classified within the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: Isaberrysaura lived during the Bajocian stage, between 170.9 and 168.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Bajocian (170.9 to 168.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossilized seeds found inside the ribcage of the holotype represent the first preserved food of a basal ornithischian.
facts.quote: Se descubrió dentro de la caja torácica una masa de semillas fosilizadas; constituyen la primera comida preservada de un ornitisquio basal

facts.statement: The larger seeds preserved three layers: a fleshy outer sarcotesta, a sclerotesta, and an inner layer possibly corresponding to the nucella.
facts.quote: Las más grandes preservaban tres capas: una sarcotesta exterior carnosa, la esclerotesta, y la capa interna, que posiblemente corresponde a la nucela

facts.statement: The larger seeds are assigned to cycads of the family Zamiineae based on a well-defined coronula in the micropylar region.
facts.quote: Estas semillas son asignadas a las cícadas de la familia Zamiineae basándose en su coronula bien definida en la región micropilar

facts.statement: Because the sarcotesta of the larger seeds remained intact, researchers suggest that Isaberrysaura swallowed the seeds whole without chewing them.
facts.quote: Dado que la sarcotesta de las mayores semillas estaba intacta se sugiere que Isaberrysaura tragaba las semillas enteras sin masticarlas

facts.statement: Based on its teeth, it is possible that Isaberrysaura had an omnivorous diet, though this is merely speculation as no animal remains were found alongside the seeds.
facts.quote: Con base en sus dientes, es posible que este dinosaurio tuviera una dieta omnívora, pero como no se encontraron restos animales junto a las semillas, esto es meramente una especulación

facts.statement: It is possible that Isaberrysaura had a bacterial flora in its intestines to help it digest plant material like seeds.
facts.quote: Por otra parte es posible que tuviera una flora bacteriana en sus intestinos para ayudarle a digerir el material vegetal como las semillas
